criteria.requirement: Fix Settings.load_file input normalization: allow None/str/text os.PathLike and finite list/tuple of those, normalize via os.fspath and validate the complete sequence before any loading. Reject modules/dicts/numbers/bytes/bad __fspath__ return values with TypeError regardless of silent. Preserve string module names, comma-list/glob and PathLike real-file behavior plus optional None/empty/no-match semantics. Do not stringify arbitrary objects into pretend paths, mutate input sequences or modify the general ensure_a_list contract across unrelated APIs.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
